description: A dynamic labyrinth feature designed to adapt and evolve based on player progress, enhancing narrative-driven gameplay.

items.title: Key Features
items: Dynamic labyrinth structure changes triggered by in-game events.
Customizable labyrinth states defined in advance by game designers.
Interactive wall actors capable of toggling their state to create new pathways.
Matrix-based system for dynamically evolving level layouts.

description: Developed as part of a collaboration with a scriptwriter, the Labyrinth System brings a dynamic and engaging level design to life. Its ever-changing layout reacts to player progress, creating new pathways and keeping gameplay unpredictable and challenging.

The Labyrinth System leverages Unreal Engine's actor-based system to generate flexible and adaptive pathways. Walls designed as 'switchers' toggle states to alter the labyrinth, creating limitless exploration possibilities while maintaining narrative coherence.

elements.description: Matrix of actors forming the labyrinth, enabling dynamic layout changes with predefined states.
Equipped with toggling capabilities to dynamically create or block pathways.
Maps defining the state of each wall actor, ensuring synchronized and cohesive changes.

description: The Labyrinth System successfully integrates into the narrative-driven gameplay, providing a unique and engaging player experience. The dynamic labyrinth reacts to player actions, maintaining interest and challenge throughout the game.
